{{Italic title|The Sacred Stones}}
This page tracks '''the availabilities of [[List of characters in Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones|the various characters]] playable in {{FE8}}'''. ''The Sacred Stones'' has two separate routes that can be selected during [[A New Journey|an interlude sequence]] after [[It's a Trap!|Chapter&nbsp;8]], with the player choosing to follow either one of twins [[Eirika]] and [[Ephraim]]. These routes feature different chapters from Chapter&nbsp;9 onwards before converging on [[Scorched Sand|Chapter&nbsp;15]]. Each route has different chapters, and some units have different availabilities between the two routes. There are no units that are exclusive to one route; all units can be recruited on both routes.

__TOC__

==Comparison==
There are twelve characters with different availabilities between the two routes:
